$comment: What the Privacy Policy says about who processes data and where. The page renders from this file, and tests/site-facts.test.ts checks every region and provider here against the code and Terraform, so a change that makes the policy untrue fails CI. Change the code and this file together.

processors.purpose: Signing you in with Apple or Google, or as a guest.
processors.data: Your account ID, email address, name (if your sign-in provider shares it) and sign-in provider.
processors.where: Google's global infrastructure, which may be outside Australia

processors.purpose: Storing your notes: transcripts, summaries, action items, decisions and search index.
Storing the audio you record or import.
Keeping your note list up to date on your devices.
processors.data: A copy of your notes (titles, status, summaries and transcripts), for fast display.

processors.service: Vertex AI: Gemini models and text embeddings (Google Cloud)
processors.purpose: Writing summaries, action items and decisions; transcribing short recordings; answering questions about your notes; building the search index.
processors.data: Your transcripts, and the audio of short recordings. Card numbers and similar identifiers are removed from transcript text before it's sent.

processors.where: Google's global endpoint, so audio may be processed outside Australia

processors.service: Cloud Logging and Error Reporting (Google Cloud)
processors.purpose: Running the service reliably and investigating faults.
processors.data: Technical records: request IDs, your account and note IDs, and error details. They're designed to exclude your recordings and note content.

processors.service: Firebase Cloud Messaging (Google) and the Apple Push Notification service
processors.purpose: Telling you when a note is ready, or couldn't be processed.
processors.data: Your device's push token and the note's ID.

processors.purpose: Finding and fixing crashes in the app.
processors.data: Crash reports: the app and OS version, device model, and an installation identifier.
processors.where: Google's global infrastructure, which may be outside Australia

processors.purpose: Handling subscriptions, when they go on sale (they aren't sold during the beta).
processors.data: Your subscription status. Apple handles payment; we never see your card.
